hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpab024ac8_featurestore "
WITH d AS (
  SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id,
    round(sqrt(power(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + power(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
    p.base_score
  FROM requests_src_1 r JOIN profiles_src_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
)
SELECT request_id, account_id, distance_deg, round(base_score - 0.1 * distance_deg, 6) AS score
FROM d ORDER BY request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|^$|Logged in|compatib|pip install|To ensure"

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab024ac8_featurestore "
WITH d AS (

)
SELECT request_id, account_id, distance_deg, round(base_score - 0.1 * distance_deg, 6) AS score
FROM d ORDER BY request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -vE "INFO:|UserWarning|^$|Logged in|compatib|pip install|To ensure"

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --json --limit 0 --catalog delta --schema mlpab024ac8_featurestore "
WITH d AS (
  SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id,
    round(sqrt(power(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + power(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
    p.base_score
  FROM requests_src_1 r JOIN profiles_src_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
)
SELECT request_id, account_id, distance_deg, round(base_score - 0.1 * distance_deg, 6) AS score
FROM d" > .tmp/scored_raw.json 2>.tmp/sql_err.log
echo "exit=$?"; wc -c .tmp/scored_raw.json; head -c 400 .tmp/scored_raw.json
tool_input.description: Capture full computed result as JSON
